· U.S. sugar tariffs + corn subsidies make HFCS 1/3 the cost of sugar, so soda companies switched in the 1980s — not for health, for profit .

· Banning sugary drink purchases in SNAP alone would prevent 279,000 obesity cases and save **$2.75B** in healthcare costs over 10 years — with $3.35 saved per $1 spent .

What needs to change:
1. Restrict SNAP purchases of sugary drinks (23 states already doing this) 
2. Restore SNAP-Ed nutrition education (defunded July 2025) — it returned up to $9.50 per $1 in healthcare savings 
3. End sugar tariffs + phase out corn subsidies — let the market price real sugar competitively instead of distorting it
